text:
ashley: Quick sync: proposing adaptive router for console renders to pick stream vs batch based on widget size, sensitivity, and recent latency.

kevin: Sounds good. Main concern: where do we enforce RBAC? Upstream or renderer?

maria: Upstream auth -> return signed perm-hash. Renderers validate perm-hash and can cache it short-term.

chao: Cache invalidation? role changes must not leak. TTL + perm-version field in hash.

ashley: Plan: perm-hash TTL=30s, include perm-version, HMAC with rotation (accept last 2 keys).

kevin: Routing heuristic idea: if widget.estimated_ms < 40 && sensitivity!=high -> stream else -> batch. Frontend can annotate estimated_ms, backend EWMA fallback.

maria: To reduce auth calls, allow post-filtering for low-sensitivity metrics only. Product must label widgets with sensitivity.

chao: For mixed dashboards, frontend batching shim to combine small adjacent widgets into one /render/batch payload. Cuts overhead.

tomas: Observability: emit render.path (stream/composite), p50/p95/p99, auth_calls_per_render, cache_hits, perm_misses. Alert if p95_stream > 300ms or auth_error_rate > 0.5%.

security: Do not log user ids. Perm-hash must be non-reversible and rotated monthly. Validate key rotation acceptance window.

kevin: API shapes: /render/stream -> SSE chunks, /render/batch -> single composite blob. Add headers X-Perm-Hash, X-Render-Mode for tracing.

maria: Cache key: tenant: view_id: perm-version: widget-shape:time-bucket. Include shard-id in metrics.

ashley: Fallbacks: if stream times out (250ms) router retries once to batch. Canary rollout under feature flag adaptive-render-v1.

deploy-bot: feature-flag "adaptive-render-v1" created at 1762620000 targeting 5% tenants.

sre-bot: synthetic-canary started at 1762620050 comparing monolith vs adaptive for 300 dashboards.

kevin: I'll draft RFC for API and rollout this week.

maria: I'll prototype perm-LRU + async refresh and share perf numbers.

ashley: Action owners noted. We'll reconvene after RFC. Thanks.
